parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a field line (line of force) in an electric field.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: An electric field has two different regions $X$ and $Y$. The field strength in $X$ is less than that in $Y$. Describe a difference between the pattern of field lines (lines of force) in $X$ and in $Y$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.part_stem: A particle $P$ has a mass of $0.15\text{ u}$ and a charge of $-1e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge.
parts.text: Particle $P$ and an $\alpha$-particle are in the same uniform electric field. Calculate the ratio $$\frac{\text{magnitude of acceleration of particle P}}{\text{magnitude of acceleration of }\alpha\text{-particle}}.$$

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
Particle $P$ is a hadron composed of only two quarks. One of them is a down ($d$) quark.

By considering charge, determine a possible type (flavour) of the other quark. Explain your working.
